title: Addiction
subtitle: Compulsion, dependency, and how the loop gets broken
lede: A reference to {videos} sources on the psychology of addiction — what drives compulsive behavior and what actually breaks the loop.
about_paragraphs: A reference built from {videos} sources on addiction and compulsive behavior — what drives it, what sustains it, and what the evidence says actually helps — synthesised into {library_files} knowledge files and {glossary_terms} glossary terms.

Every claim traces to a specific point in a specific source — a page, a paragraph, or a video timestamp, depending on what kind of source made the claim. Nothing here is generated: there is no model in this app, and it makes no network requests. It works offline, permanently.
